meta.title: Marahil — Tutoring & Online Courses Platform
meta.description: Marahil: interactive lessons, instant quizzes, and verified certificates for every school stage.

hero.title: Your tutoring and courses, all in one place
hero.subtitle: Teachers build lessons, quizzes, and certificates with ease, for every stage and subject, while students learn with instant feedback, step by step, all the way to a certificate.

stages.title: One curriculum for every age, every subject
stages.description: From kindergarten to university and professional training, every subject is built with the same ease and the same quality.

howItWorks.title: From a teacher's idea... to a student's certificate

steps.title: The teacher publishes a lesson
steps.desc: Upload a video or file, add written notes and questions.

steps.title: The student learns smartly
steps.desc: Automatic progress tracking and quick questions during the lesson.

steps.title: A quiz measures understanding
steps.desc: Questions graded instantly, with insight into strengths and weaknesses.

steps.title: A verified certificate is issued
steps.desc: A signed digital certificate with a unique code for every student.

features.title: Everything a teacher needs, in one place
features.description: From the first lesson you publish to the last certificate you issue, with tools built to save your time.

items.title: Video & File Lessons
items.desc: Upload your lessons as video or PDF, organized into units and chapters.

items.title: Complete Curricula
items.desc: Build a full curriculum in clear order, from the first lesson to the last unit.

items.title: Question Bank & Quizzes
items.desc: Multiple-choice questions with instant automatic grading.

items.title: Verified Digital Certificates
items.desc: A certificate for every student with a unique code anyone can verify.

items.title: Live Analytics
items.desc: Track every student's progress, completion rates, and average scores.

items.title: Direct Communication
items.desc: Student questions reach the teacher directly.

demo.title: Try an interactive lesson now
demo.description: This is how students feel instant feedback on every quiz — answer, correction, and explanation in the same moment.

questions.question: Which gas do body cells need to breathe?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is the primary gas cells use.

testimonial.quote: I moved my entire subject to Marahil within a single week. Students started asking when the next lesson is, instead of me chasing them.
testimonial.name: Sara Youssef

cta.title: Start building your digital classroom today
cta.description: No setup costs, no complexity. Publish your first lesson in minutes.
